abstract.t: This document specifies an extension to the JSON Meta Application Protocol (JMAP) that lets a client find and restore objects that were permanently destroyed within a server-defined retention period. It defines a new capability, a DeletedItem data type that describes a destroyed object of any supported data type, and a DeletedItem/ restore method that recreates it. Rules are given for Email, ContactCard, CalendarEvent, FileNode, and SieveScript objects. Servers can already keep destroyed data for a time. This extension gives clients an interoperable way to show what can be recovered, for how long, and to recover it.
